bio.text: Sheila Lieder is a Democrat who represents District 28 (Jefferson County) in the Colorado House of Representatives, where she took office on January 9, 2023; Ballotpedia lists her as a 2026 candidate for Colorado State Senate District 20.
According to Ballotpedia, her career includes experience in the telecom industry and work as legislative and political director for the Communications Workers of America in Colorado and Wyoming.
It says she earned a high school diploma from Central High School and a telecommunications engineering certificate from the University of Phoenix.
